text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Replied in the thread on your message in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836, and you logged both lanes as working at 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM).

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
